gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots and one for the walkthrough, whose live run the live screenshots were then taken on
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.live_model: the operator's own installed, signed-in kiro-cli over ACP with model "auto"; the replies on screen are that model's and vary from run to run
agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway served this repository's own copy of the app: capture.py's setup installed it from this checkout (POST /api/apps/install), trusted it and enabled it, and every picture shows its committed bundle (ui/dist/index.mjs) and backend. Kiro Crew still ships a built-in spec-builder and refuses a second install under the same name, so the Kiro Crew tree the capture ran on is the App Kit level-1 commit the tests pin, with only the built-in copy removed (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/spec_builder and its BUILTIN_NAMES row); kirocrew_tree_dirty records that. The folder picker's first listing (the gateway user's home folder) was sent to the demo projects folder instead, so no real home folder appears; the app answered that listing as it answers any folder.
data_notes: The project is a made-up library holds service (Fernleaf Library, capture/fixtures/fernleaf-library), copied for each gateway to /tmp/spec-builder-demo/fernleaf-library and committed there by a fictional author. Every name and the .example email addresses in it are invented.

The specs were created through the app's own New spec form (the walkthrough) and its POST /specs route (the bug spec), so the agent's first message, its questions and every document came from a live model and differ from run to run.
The agent's tool calls were approved with the chat's own Trust button, as a person would.
